name: helionyx
description: Size hybrid solar PV, wind, battery, diesel and grid systems: hourly simulation, NPC ranking.
long_description: Open-source MCP server for pre-feasibility sizing of hybrid renewable energy systems. It simulates every candidate design hour by hour for a year, drops designs that break constraints and ranks the rest by net present cost, so the assistant only explains numbers that come from a reproducible solver run. Includes a Sri Lankan tariff pack (CEB/LECO) with unverified placeholder data, sensitivity and Pareto analysis, multi-year expansion, HOMER CSV export and Markdown/Excel reports. Results are pre-feasibility estimates, not engineering design; see the disclaimer.

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Register a site (location, time zone and country pack). Returns site_id.

tools.name: fetch_resource
tools.description: Get one year of hourly GHI, temperature and wind for a site, aligned to local civil time. Returns summary statistics only; the hourly series is available as a resource.

tools.name: import_timeseries
tools.description: Import a measured load or resource series from CSV (one year, 15/30/60-minute resolution), or extend at least four weeks of measured load to a full year.

tools.name: synthesize_load
tools.description: Build an 8,760-hour load from pack archetypes, optionally calibrated to monthly bills.

tools.name: list_tariffs
tools.description: Browse the tariff pack (utility, category, effective dates, export schemes).

tools.name: get_tariff
tools.description: Show a tariff's charge structure, TOU periods, export schemes, provenance and staleness warnings.

tools.name: compute_bill
tools.description: Monthly and annual bill for a load with no system (baseline), or for import/export series.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Browse the component library: technical parameters, costs, currency, cost year and source.

tools.name: create_scenario
tools.description: Combine site, loads, resource, grid/tariff, components and search space into a scenario. Unset fields take pack defaults; call validate_scenario next to see them.

tools.name: validate_scenario
tools.description: Check a scenario: errors block a run, warnings do not; assumptions list every value with its origin (user, pack_default or system_default), source and date.

tools.name: run_optimization
tools.description: Start an asynchronous run that simulates every candidate for 8,760 hours and ranks feasible ones. Returns job_id and run_id; poll get_job_status, then call get_results.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Poll a job: state (queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled, interrupted), progress %, ETA, run_id.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running job.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Ranked feasible designs with sizes and key metrics, the base case, provenance and disclaimer. The full table is the resource hnx://runs/{run_id}/results.csv.

tools.name: get_pareto_front
tools.description: Designs on the Pareto front of NPC, annual CO2 and capacity shortage, including designs that break a constraint (flagged), to show cost versus emissions versus reliability trade-offs.

tools.name: explain_run
tools.description: Structured facts about one design: NPC breakdown and shares, top cost drivers, binding constraints, dispatch statistics, differences from the next design or base case, and the most uncertain inputs.

tools.name: get_monthly_summary
tools.description: Twelve months of energy flows and, for grid-connected runs, the bill before and after.

tools.name: run_sensitivity
tools.description: Re-optimise the scenario for each value (or each pair of values in a two-variable grid) and compute NPC elasticities. Returns job_id and batch_id; then call get_sensitivity_results.

tools.name: get_sensitivity_results
tools.description: Optimal design for each sweep value and the NPC elasticity at the base point.

tools.name: compare_runs
tools.description: Side-by-side sizes and key metrics of several runs (e.g. native vs REopt), with differences.

tools.name: export_homer_csv
tools.description: Write HOMER-importable load and resource series (8,760 rows) plus a parameter sheet.

tools.name: export_report
tools.description: Write a client report as Markdown or Excel: scenario, assumptions, top designs, cost breakdown, monthly table, sensitivities, provenance and disclaimer.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Where Helionyx keeps its database, results and exports.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.description: Use only cached and bundled data; no calls to NASA POWER or PVGIS.

reopt_api_key.title: REopt API key (optional)
reopt_api_key.description: Only for the reopt cross-check solver; sends load data to NREL.
